1. (Currently amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a [[macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC)]] __protein macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC), wherein the protein MAAC comprises bevacizumab,__ to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about [[250 C. of at least about 10 cps]] __25° C. of at least 10 cps__ at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity, __wherein the viscosity inducing component comprises hyaluronic acid, and wherein the ocular condition comprises macular degeneration.__

3. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

4. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein the MAAC comprises [[an agent selected from the group consisting of a nucleic acid (a oligonucleotide) and a polypeptide]] __a protein__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein.
